2609.39820.title: Learning from Runtime Feedback through Failure-Bank Self-Evolution for Vision-Language-Action Models
2609.39820.paper_summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generalize broadly across robotic manipulation tasks, but complex environments require balancing task success with unintended contact. Runtime shields can correct individual actions, but they leave the underlying policy unchanged, so repeated disagreements may create a persistent policy-shield mismatch that blocks task progress. To address this challenge, we introduce FailBank, a four-stage self-evolving framework that converts runtime feedback into persistent policy improvement. During collection, a fixed CBF-based safety module serves as an observe-only teacher, producing counterfactual corrections while the policy remains in control. Outcome-aware admission then converts useful proposals into corrective targets and retains successful uncorrected actions as quiet anchors for guarded LoRA updates. We evaluate FailBank on the VLA-Arena benchmark across two difficulty levels and two VLA backbones. Compared with the base policies, FailBank improves the joint success-cost operating point. Across the two backbones, FailBank improves task success rate by 8.5 and 6.9 percentage points, while reducing policy-induced cumulative cost by 35.6\% and 23.8\%, respectively. Compared with runtime shielding, FailBank raises task success rate by 25.4 and 9.5 percentage points, while maintaining comparable policy-induced cumulative cost. These results show that runtime feedback can serve as persistent policy supervision rather than only as a temporary action constraint.
2609.39820.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動 (VLA) 模型在機器人操作任務中具有廣泛的泛化能力，但複雜的環境需要平衡任務成功與意外接觸之間的關係。運行時保護可以修正個別行動，但它們不改變基礎政策，因此重複的分歧可能會造成持續的政策-保護不匹配，從而阻礙任務進展。為了解決這一挑戰，我們引入了 FailBank，一個四階段自我演化框架，將運行時反饋轉化為持久的政策改進。在收集階段，固定的基於 CBF 的安全模組作為僅觀察的教師，產生反事實的修正，同時政策保持控制。結果感知的接納隨後將有用的提議轉化為修正目標，並將成功的未修正行動保留為安全的錨點，以便進行受控的 LoRA 更新。我們在 VLA-Arena 基準上對 FailBank 進行了評估，涵蓋了兩個難度級別和兩個 VLA 骨幹。與基礎政策相比，FailBank 改善了聯合成功-成本操作點。在這兩個骨幹中，FailBank 分別提高了任務成功率 8.5 和 6.9 個百分點，同時將政策引起的累積成本分別降低了 35.6\% 和 23.8\%。與運行時保護相比，FailBank 將任務成功率提高了 25.4 和 9.5 個百分點，同時保持了可比的政策引起的累積成本。這些結果顯示，運行時反饋可以作為持久的政策監督，而不僅僅是臨時的行動約束。
